 runs(t).forEach(function(r){cx.font=fnt(sz,r[1]);
  var base=r[1]?(o.y+0.87*sz):(o.y+0.08*sz+0.93*0.85*sz);
  if(o.stroke){cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=alpha;cx.lineJoin='round';cx.lineWidth=Math.max(2,sz*0.14);
   cx.strokeStyle=(o.color=='#000000')?'#ffffff':'rgba(0,0,0,.85)';cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.5)';cx.shadowBlur=sz*0.15;cx.shadowOffsetY=sz*0.04;cx.strokeText(r[0],x,base);cx.restore()}
  cx.fillText(r[0],x,base);x+=cx.measureText(r[0]).width});
 cx.restore()}

function draw(preview){
 if(preview===undefined)preview=true;
 var c=cur=='custom'?customCfg():CFG[cur];cv.width=c.W;cv.height=c.H;
 if(cur=='custom'){if(custom)cx.drawImage(custom,0,0,c.W,c.H);else{cx.fillStyle='#dfe6ef';cx.fillRect(0,0,c.W,c.H);cx.fillStyle='#456';cx.textAlign='center';cx.font=fnt(c.W/16,true);cx.fillText('మీ పోస్టర్ ఇక్కడ వస్తుంది',c.W/2,c.H/2);cx.textAlign='left'}}
 else if(bg[cur])cx.drawImage(bg[cur],0,0,c.W,c.H);
 if(c.cover&&custom&&$('pp').value>0)drawPatch(c);
 if(c.leaders)drawLeaders(c);
 if(photo){
  var z=$('zoom').value/100,ox=$('ox').value/100,oy=$('oy').value/100;
  if(isCut){
   var b=cutBox,bw=b.w,bh=b.h,k=Math.min(c.cut.w/bw,c.cut.h/bh)*z;
   var dw=bw*k,dh=bh*k;
   var dx=c.cut.x+c.cut.w/2-dw/2+ox*(c.free?c.W*0.5:c.cut.w*0.5),dy=c.cut.bottom-dh+(c.free?oy*c.H*0.5:0);
   cx.drawImage(photo,b.x,b.y,bw,bh,dx,dy,dw,dh);
   if(c.plateY&&bg[cur])cx.drawImage(bg[cur],0,c.plateY,c.W,c.H-c.plateY,0,c.plateY,c.W,c.H-c.plateY);
  }else{
   var iw=photo.width,ih=photo.height,side=Math.min(iw,ih)/z;
   if(c.free){z=1;side=Math.min(iw,ih);ox=0;oy=0}
   var scx=iw/2+ox*(iw-side)/2,scy=Math.min(ih*0.42,ih/2)+oy*(ih-side)/2;
   if(ih<=iw)scy=ih/2+oy*(ih-side)/2;
   var sx=Math.max(0,Math.min(iw-side,scx-side/2)),sy=Math.max(0,Math.min(ih-side,scy-side/2));
   var ci=c.circ;if(c.free){ci={cx:ci.cx+$('ox').value/100*c.W*0.5,cy:ci.cy+$('oy').value/100*c.H*0.5,D:ci.D,rings:ci.rings}}var R=ci.D/2,tot=0;
   ci.rings.forEach(function(r){tot+=r[0]});
   var rr=R;
   var rs=ci.rings.slice().reverse();
   var acc=0;ci.rings.forEach(function(r){acc+=r[0]});
   // draw rings from outermost
   var sorted=ci.rings.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b[0]-a[0]});
   sorted.forEach(function(r){cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ci.cx,ci.cy,R+r[0],0,6.2832);cx.fillStyle=r[1];cx.fill()});
   cx.save();cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ci.cx,ci.cy,R,0,6.2832);cx.clip();
   cx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
   cx.drawImage(photo,sx,sy,side,side,ci.cx-R,ci.cy-R,ci.D,ci.D);cx.restore();
  }
 }else if(preview){
  var ci=c.circ;if(c.free){ci={cx:ci.cx+$('ox').value/100*c.W*0.5,cy:ci.cy+$('oy').value/100*c.H*0.5,D:ci.D}}cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=.5;cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ci.cx,ci.cy,ci.D/2,0,6.2832);cx.fill();
  cx.globalAlpha=1;cx.fillStyle='#456';cx.font=fnt(ci.D/9,true);cx.textAlign='center';cx.fillText('మీ ఫోటో',ci.cx,ci.cy);cx.restore()}
 var n=$('nm').value.trim(),t=$('tt').value.trim();
 if(c.cover)drawPlate(c);
 drawLine(n||(preview?'మీ పేరు':''),c.name,n?1:.45);
 drawLine(t||(preview?'మీ పదవి':''),c.title,t?1:.45);
}

function drawPatch(c){
 var W=c.W,H=c.H,ph=$('pp').value/100*H,top=c.pt-ph,g=custom.getContext('2d'),B=8,i;
 if(top<0)top=0;var h=c.pt+4-top;
 for(i=0;i<h;i+=B){var y=top+i,bh=Math.min(B,h-i);
  var L=g.getImageData(2,Math.round(y),6,Math.max(1,Math.round(bh))).data,R=g.getImageData(W-8,Math.round(y),6,Math.max(1,Math.round(bh))).data,a=[0,0,0],b=[0,0,0],n=L.length/4,j;
  for(j=0;j<L.length;j+=4){a[0]+=L[j];a[1]+=L[j+1];a[2]+=L[j+2];b[0]+=R[j];b[1]+=R[j+1];b[2]+=R[j+2]}
  var gr=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,0);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgb('+Math.round(a[0]/n)+','+Math.round(a[1]/n)+','+Math.round(a[2]/n)+')');
  gr.addColorStop(1,'rgb('+Math.round(b[0]/n)+','+Math.round(b[1]/n)+','+Math.round(b[2]/n)+')');
  cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(i+B)/Math.max(B,h*0.22));cx.fillStyle=gr;cx.fillRect(0,y,W,bh+1);cx.restore()}
 var f=cx.createLinearGradient(0,top-H*0.04,0,top);f.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
 cx.save();cx.globalCompositeOperation='destination-over';cx.restore()}
function drawPlate(c){
 var W=c.W,H=c.H,pt=c.pt,ph=H*c.ph,g=cx.createLinearGradient(0,pt,0,H);
 g.addColorStop(0,'#12843a');g.addColorStop(1,'#07501f');
 cx.fillStyle=g;cx.fillRect(0,pt,W,ph+1);
 cx.fillStyle='#ffffff';cx.fillRect(0,pt-Math.max(2,H*0.003),W,Math.max(3,H*0.004));
 cx.fillStyle='#ff9933';cx.fillRect(0,pt-Math.max(2,H*0.003)*2.6,W,Math.max(3,H*0.004))}

function prep(im,MAX){
 var sc=Math.min(1,MAX/Math.max(im.width,im.height));
 var w=Math.round(im.width*sc),h=Math.round(im.height*sc);
 var cc=document.createElement('canvas');cc.width=w;cc.height=h;var g=cc.getContext('2d');g.drawImage(im,0,0,w,h);
 var d=g.getImageData(0,0,w,h).data,tr=0,minx=w,miny=h,maxx=0,maxy=0;
 for(var y=0;y<h;y++)for(var x=0;x<w;x++){var a=d[(y*w+x)*4+3];if(a<200)tr++;if(a>20){if(x<minx)minx=x;if(x>maxx)maxx=x;if(y<miny)miny=y;if(y>maxy)maxy=y}}
 var cut=(tr/(w*h)>0.02)&&maxx>minx&&maxy>miny;
 return {cc:cc,cut:cut,box:cut?{x:minx,y:miny,w:maxx-minx+1,h:maxy-miny+1}:null}}

function drawLeaders(c){

 var P=Math.min(c.W/n,n>7?100:124),sz=n>7?80:104,top=8,GAP=(L[0].g!=L[n-1].g)?18:0,tot=n*P+GAP,x0=(c.W-tot)/2,pos=[],gx=0;

 L.forEach(function(l,i){var cxp=pos[i],im=ldImg(l.photo),x=cxp-sz/2;
  cx.save();cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.beginPath();cx.roundRect?cx.roundRect(x-4,top-4,sz+8,sz+8,14):cx.rect(x-4,top-4,sz+8,sz+8);cx.fill();
  cx.beginPath();cx.roundRect?cx.roundRect(x,top,sz,sz,11):cx.rect(x,top,sz,sz);cx.clip();
  if(im)cx.drawImage(im,0,0,im.width,im.height,x,top,sz,sz);else{cx.fillStyle='#dde6f3';cx.fillRect(x,top,sz,sz)}
  cx.restore();
  if(i<n-1&&l.g!=L[i+1].g){cx.save();cx.fillStyle='#10307a';cx.fillRect((pos[i]+pos[i+1])/2-1.5,14,3,96);cx.restore()}
 })}
